description: This PHP source file defines a class ConfiguratorViewHistoryContactsEmails which extends SugarView, responsible for rendering a configuration page that allows administrators to manage email history contacts for different modules in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for pre-display authorization checks and for generating the configuration data by analyzing subpanel definitions related to contact history emails.

classes.name: ConfiguratorViewHistoryContactsEmails
classes.description: A view class for managing the display and configuration of email history contacts in SuiteCRM, specifically for administration purposes.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the current user is an administrator before allowing the display of this view; terminates execution if not authorized.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Gathers modules with relevant subpanel configurations related to 'History' and collections with specific get_subpanel_data functions, then assigns this data to the view template for rendering.
